msg: Bonjour, nous sommes deux plongeurs niveau 2 FFESSM, à Carthagène en février. Nous aimerions plonger deux jours. C'est combien, et est-ce que notre brevet français est accepté ?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

A two-day dive plan in the Rosario Islands is a great way to enjoy the reef! Your FFESSM Level 2 certification should be suitable for certified-diver outings; please bring your certification cards.

You'll also need:
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch on the first day
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
• 5 Dives - 2 days: 392 USD · 436 USD (1.429.000 COP · 1.587.000 COP)
• 7 Dives - 3 days: 503 USD · 558 USD (1.813.000 COP · 2.015.000 COP)
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD (720.000 COP · 800.000 COP)
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD (1.000.000 COP · 1.110.000 COP)
• 7-dive package (3 days): 432 USD · 480 USD (1.375.000 COP · 1.526.000 COP)

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Yes from Cartagena. Sorry can you answer in French? We want 4 dives over 2 days. Dernière plongée il y a 6 mois. Nous sommes français.
reply:
Bien sûr, je peux vous répondre en français ! Pour deux plongeurs certifiés, le forfait comprend 4 plongées guidées sur 2 jours, le transport en bateau depuis Carthagène, l’équipement, l’assurance plongée, l’entrée au parc et le déjeuner du premier jour. Le logement sur les îles et le déjeuner du deuxième jour ne sont pas inclus.

Le départ se fait à 8 h depuis le Muelle de la Bodeguita. Vous devrez passer une nuit sur les îles, puis le retour à Carthagène est prévu vers 16 h 15 le deuxième jour. Comme votre dernière plongée remonte à 6 mois, le rappel normalement requis après plus de 2 ans ne s’applique pas. Pensez à apporter vos cartes de certification FFESSM.

Je vous partage les détails du forfait juste en dessous.

🤿 *4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives)*
💰 *316 USD* per person · 2 people
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 4 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch on day 1 and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

ℹ️ More information here:
https://divingplanet.org/tours-buceo-snorkel-cartagena/

👉 To book this, let me know and I'll connect you with an advisor who arranges the details with you.

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
